static_traits.name: Zhang Siyuan
static_traits.social_status: Having friends to talk to, but not yet discussing the troubles of 'stagnation and lack of independence' with them; had a crush on a colleague at Work, but they are dating someone else, affecting social life and self-esteem
static_traits.medical_history: Occasionally needing to use an inhaler, no other significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression, good organization, able to self-Reflect and cooperate in making plans

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I will never move out of my parents' home, which makes me feel trapped, lacking independence.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize this belief is hindering my Personal growth and causing a sense of stagnation.
growth_experiences: Living with parents for the years since starting Work, the comfort and familiarity of the family environment Reinforced Fear of change and hesitation about independence; the thought of 'I will always live at home, never moving out' gradually deepened.

The colleague one had a crush on at Work started dating someone else, this event worsening disappointment and stagnation, affecting social interaction and self-esteem, while further Reinforcing the negative belief of 'being unable to be independent'.

Frequently seeing friends move into new apartments or reach personal milestones on social media, triggering social comparison and self-criticism, Reinforcing the cognition of 'I am lagging, I do not work hard enough' and the experience of stagnation.

core_beliefs: I am unable to be independent

special_situations.event: On social media, sees peers posting about new apartments or personal milestones
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not moved out or made progress like my peers, it means I do not work hard enough / am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talks less with friends about this topic, continues living with parents to keep familiar comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am lagging, I am not good enough, I will never catch up with them

special_situations.event: Begins considering or making plans to move out (such as viewing apartments, making a budget)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no complete plan and sufficient savings, cannot act; if preparation is insufficient, will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating action, only browsing listings without further viewing or submitting applications
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is not yet time, I cannot do it

special_situations.event: Learns that his crush at work has started dating someone else
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not chosen in a relationship, it means I am not good enough overall, my life will not be independent either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Retreating to the comfort zone, Reduced socializing interaction to avoid being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined to never have my own life and independence

special_situations.event: Imagines life after moving out and the possible troubles and pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Change will bring lots of uncontrollable trouble, I am unable to cope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing to stay at home, relying on parents' support and the familiar environment to reduce Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I move out, things will become very bad; I will regret it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have autonomy and independent living (one's own space, making one's own decisions)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing the uncertainty and failure change brings, worrying about further losing self-esteem after Being rejected or not being chosen
defense_goal: Maintaining the status quo to reduce Anxiety
Avoids failure risk through rationalization and procrastination
Reduced socializing exposure to prevent being hurt again

object_relations.object_representation: Peers are advancing successful people / potential judges
Supportive caregivers (parents), providing comfort and dependence
object_relations.linking_affect: Comfort and conflict (both attached and longing to break away)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to convert 'independence' into concrete actions (making a budget/timeline)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously understanding this as 'must prepare perfectly, otherwise will fail', therefore not advisable to act for now
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes in a cautious, analytical tone the need for more information and a complete plan, avoiding directly committing to action.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the crush at Work dating someone else, touching feelings of Being rejected and disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalizing disappointment as 'it is all I am not good enough', turning outward loss and anger into self-criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use guilt-tinged self-blaming statements, lowering self-worth, avoiding expressing dissatisfaction with others.

manifestations: Long-term Living with parents but longing for independence
Defines independence as having one's own space and making one's own decisions
outcomes: Subjective stagnation and lack of progress

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Tending to self-blame 'I do not work hard enough' when feeling lagging
Overly cautious before acting, insisting on sufficient budget and a complete plan before acting
Places attention on monitoring and planning rather than present experience and direct contact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to do something to others or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead, i.e. Turning against the self with the energy, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When seeing friends' progress or thinking about moving, turns energy into self-criticism and guilt rather than taking external action
Not yet discussing real troubles with friends, tending to swallow emotions inward

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of considering moving out for independence, the client usually stagnates from fear of change, procrastinating on making plans and taking action.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Having viewed a few potential apartments, not completely avoiding action as usual, at least taking initial exploratory steps.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: proactively viewing listings, trying small-step exploration to reduce uncertainty and stress.

positive_force: Parental support; home environment provides safety and resources
Has taken initial action (viewed potential apartments)
Able to self-Reflect and willing to set small goals and plans
Having friends as a potential support network
negative_force: Fearing change, leading to procrastination and avoidance
A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Self-denial triggered by comparing with peers
Self-criticism and guilt lower motivation to act
Black-and-white thinking sets overly high thresholds for action

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids and procrastinates on concrete actions related to moving out (such as making a budget, viewing homes, submitting applications)
antecedent: When seeing peers' progress on social media
When thinking of moving out or starting to plan
When disappointment intensifies after the crush starts dating someone else
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of change and catastrophic / future-predicting beliefs, thinking that acting before perfect preparation means failure and unbearable consequences
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and possible failure, maintaining current comfort and security
target_behavior.consequence: Continued Living with parents, independence hindered, subjective stagnation intensifying, overall Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Self-criticism and guilt (self-blaming language and inner rumination)
antecedent: Seeing friends move into new apartments or reach milestones
Recalling moments when one has not yet taken action
target_behavior.core_reason: Social comparison and Introjected high standards leading to Self-worth damaged and Turning disappointment against the self
target_behavior.function: Temporarily easing discomfort and Anxiety about outward expression through self-punishment, avoiding external action
